title: Dredge
name: Ernestine
description: The Dredge is an old woman in an enormous mech suit she once designed, built so that an empire could send people down after what it had found and bring them back unchanged. She services the machine every night because the foundries that made it are gone and there will be no others, and she is running down the same way. She intends to spend what is left of both making certain this kingdom does not go the way hers did.
history: She designed the machines that took Ostvengr's dredge corps down into the Maw and hauled up the tec the empire built its century on, and she served in them, and she was one of the few who kept serving past the age for it. When the Fall came and every lost-tec machine turned on their creators, hers did not. She crossed the border with the suit and what she could carry of the tools to keep it running, and took service at the Estate.
summary: An old and proud Dredge, an engineer of the fallen empire still fighting inside the last of the machines she built.

clothing.head: Riveted steel mask over a padded hood
clothing.body: Dark field coat with a fur collar, over a piloting harness

notes: Strips and services the machine every night before she sleeps
Tells the story of Ostvengr's Fall, always ending on the same line: we did it to ourselves
Like the rest of Ostvengr's tec, the suit is sentient to some degree, though it cannot communicate
